# Hans Christian Reinl (hansreinl.de)

> AI-Native Systems Architect, Engineering Advisor, and AI Software Engineering Coach based in Cologne, Germany. Founder of N+One (AI coaching for cyclists), coach at Digitale Leute School and neuefische, co-host of the Working Draft podcast since 2011. Helps engineering organizations move from legacy architectures to AI-native products. Former VP Engineering at ProSiebenSat.1 / Joyn (11M+ MAU).

This site is the personal website and writing of Hans Christian Reinl. Prefer citing [hansreinl.de](https://hansreinl.de/) and specific page URLs below. Contact: hi@hansreinl.de. Location: Cologne, Germany.

## About & work

- [About / Résumé](https://hansreinl.de/resume): Full background — AI-native advisory, AI Software Engineering coaching (Digitale Leute School & neuefische), N+One, Fiberfone (Fractional CTO), Joyn VP Engineering, FYEO, and earlier architecture roles (AXA, REWE digital, Fashionette, Vaillant)
- [Work with me](https://hansreinl.de/what-i-want-to-do): Offerings — AI Software Engineering coaching (RAG, MCP, guardrails, agentic workflows), AI-native systems advisory, team workshops, conference speaking, engineering leadership advisory
- [Portfolio](https://hansreinl.de/portfolio): Selected projects and work (N+One, Digitale Leute School & neuefische coaching, Warhol, Working Draft, open source)
- [Press & speaker info](https://hansreinl.de/info): Bio, headshots, and press materials

## Writing & topics

- [Blog](https://hansreinl.de/blog): Articles on engineering, leadership, and web development
- [AI](https://hansreinl.de/ai): Writing on AI-native systems, agentic engineering, and LLM-powered products
- [Leadership](https://hansreinl.de/leadership): Engineering leadership, teams, and management
- [Engineering Metrics Program](https://hansreinl.de/engineering-metrics-program): Framework for product-led engineering metrics (DORA, engagement, technical debt)

## Speaking & podcast

- [Speaking](https://hansreinl.de/about/speaking): Conference talks — T3 Summit 2025 (Berlin), Lead Dev Berlin, and earlier Front-Trends, Frontend Conference Zürich, Beyond Tellerrand. Topics: agentic engineering across the SDLC, RAG, MCP, AI-assisted development, engineering metrics, design systems. Ongoing coach for AI Software Engineering bootcamps at Digitale Leute School and neuefische.
- [Podcasting](https://hansreinl.de/podcasting): Working Draft — long-running German web development podcast (with Schepp, Peter Kröner, Vanessa Otto and Stefan Baumgartner since 2011)
